issue: Edit action fully disabled for blocked tasks instead of allowing partial edit
actual: For blocked task "Complete tax filing", the Edit button is rendered with the disabled attribute and cannot be clicked at all (Playwright click timed out: 'element is not enabled'). There is no alternate inline control to modify description or priority while blocked, so users cannot change description/priority as required, only title/deadline should be locked.

evidence: Created "QA Minimal Task" with title only; active count went 5→6, task appears in active list with Medium default priority.

Created "QA Full Task" with description "A full task description for QA testing.", deadline Sep 15, priority High, prerequisite "Buy groceries". Task rendered with all these fields and correctly shown as blocked by the prerequisite.

Edited "QA Minimal Task" -> title/description/deadline/priority/prerequisite all updated and persisted (shows "QA Minimal Task Updated", Low priority, Oct 1 deadline, blocked by Schedule dentist appointment). Deleted "QA Full Task" - it disappeared from list and active count decremented 7→6.
Completed "Buy groceries": active count 6→5, completed count 2→3, task now appears in Completed view with completed state.

Active toggle shows only active tasks with count "Active N"; Completed toggle shows only completed tasks with count "Completed N"; switching between them updates the list and selected state correctly.

Assigned "Buy groceries" as prerequisite to "QA Full Task" and "Schedule dentist appointment" as prerequisite to "QA Minimal Task Updated" via the form's prerequisite checkboxes; both tasks saved and displayed blocked state referencing the correct prerequisite.

Blocked task "Complete tax filing" shows state=blocked, complete toggle has disabled attribute, opacity-50/cursor-not-allowed styling, and click attempt failed as element not enabled - completion action unavailable while prerequisite incomplete.
Single prerequisite case: "Complete tax filing" shows 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete'. Multiple prerequisite case: "Submit final report" shows '2 prerequisites incomplete'.

Completing "Review project proposal" then "Complete tax filing" progressively unblocked "Submit final report" (2 prerequisites), which became active/eligible for completion once both prerequisites were done. Complete button was disabled while blocked and enabled once eligible.

Editing "Schedule dentist appointment" (task2), the prerequisite list excludes "QA Minimal Task Updated" which currently depends on task2 - selecting it would create a cycle. Only self and non-cycle-forming tasks (1,3,4,5,6,7) are offered.
Typing whitespace-only text "   " into the title field keeps the Create Task submit button disabled, preventing task creation. Cancelling left task list unchanged.

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves a completed dependent task simultaneously completed and blocked
actual: Completed "Review project proposal" and its dependent "Complete tax filing", then reopened "Review project proposal" (toggled back to active). The app did not prevent this reopening and did not revert "Complete tax filing" to incomplete: it remains only in the Completed view with toggle state="completed" (checked, disabled) while simultaneously showing the blocking warning 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete' and a disabled edit button. This is the exact invalid completed+blocked state CS-22 prohibits.

evidence: Completed tasks (Buy groceries, Review project proposal, etc.) remained visible in the Completed view across multiple subsequent actions until explicitly reopened (moved back to Active, as with "Review project proposal") or deleted (as tested in FT-6) - never disappeared on their own.

Hovering the dashed dependency connection line (SVG path, stroke-dasharray) triggers a tooltip titled "Dependency Chain" listing "Submit final report" (pending), "Review project proposal" (pending), and "Complete tax filing" (completed, checkmark+strikethrough), showing both the chain and each task's completion state.

Hovering the "Prerequisite ... incomplete" warning label on blocked task "Submit final report" shows the same "Dependency Chain" tooltip, identifying which prerequisites are still pending ("Submit final report" and "Review project proposal" marked pending) vs completed.

Tasks display title (heading) and priority (flag badge) always; description shown as paragraph and deadline shown with calendar icon only when supplied (confirmed absent for "QA Minimal Task" without deadline); blocked tasks show a warning badge with prerequisite state; completed tasks render title with "line-through text-muted-foreground" styling distinguishing them from active tasks.
